title: 形容词比较级与最高级（规则变化+不规则，good→better→best）
knowledgePoint: 形容词比较级与最高级的规则变化（单音节/双音节/多音节）、不规则变化（good/bad/many/much/little/far）、比较级与最高级的语境适配（两者/三者及以上比较）、同级比较（as...as/not as...as）、特殊结构（the+比较级，the+比较级；比较级+and+比较级）

questions.question: Among all the natural disasters, earthquakes are often ______ to predict, and their aftermath can be ______ destructive than other hazards.
questions.explanation: 第一空表“更难预测”（两者以上比较的隐含对比），单音节形容词“hard”的比较级为“harder”；第二空“than”提示用比较级，多音节形容词“destructive”前加“more”。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 单音节形容词的比较级直接加“-er”，多音节形容词需加“more”，需根据词的音节判断变化形式。

questions.question: The more we understand about marine ecosystems, the more we realize how fragile they are—overfishing is one of the most serious threats to ocean biodiversity.
questions.explanation: “the+比较级，the+比较级”结构使用正确，“fragile”的比较级“more fragile”符合多音节词规则；“most serious”搭配范围“to ocean biodiversity”，最高级用法正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: “the+比较级，the+比较级”结构中，前后比较级需对应，且多音节词需完整使用“more+原级”。

questions.question: When comparing the two poetry collections, Collection A is ______ in emotional depth, while Collection B is ______ in linguistic innovation.
questions.explanation: 第一空单音节形容词“rich”的比较级为“richer”；第二空多音节形容词“innovative”的比较级为“more innovative”，与前文“richer”形成对应比较。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 单音节形容词直接加“-er”，双音节及以上形容词加“more”，是比较级变化的核心规则。

questions.question: This is the more interesting novel I’ve read this year, as its plot is far more intricate than the others I’ve finished.
questions.explanation: “I’ve read this year”是三者及以上的范围，需用最高级“most interesting”，题干误用比较级“more interesting”。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 最高级需搭配明确的范围（如in/of/among/ever等），表“在……中最……”。

questions.question: The ______ the distance between two objects, the ______ the gravitational force between them—this is a key principle in Newtonian physics.
questions.explanation: “the+比较级，the+比较级”结构中，单音节形容词“great”“weak”的比较级直接加“-er”，表“距离越远，引力越弱”的物理规律。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 单音节形容词以“辅音+元音+辅音”结尾时，比较级需双写尾字母（如big→bigger），但“great”“weak”不符合此规则，直接加“-er”。

questions.question: Though the new smartphone is not as lightweight as its predecessor, it has a more longer battery life and a higher-resolution display.
questions.explanation: “longer”本身是比较级，不能再用“more”修饰；“higher-resolution”是复合形容词，比较级用法正确，题干存在“more+比较级”的冗余错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 比较级前不能加“more”（多音节词除外），避免重复修饰。

questions.question: Of all the candidates applying for the scholarship, she has the ______ academic record and the ______ letters of recommendation.
questions.explanation: “Of all the candidates”是最高级范围，单音节形容词“strong”的最高级为“strongest”；多音节形容词“compelling”的最高级为“most compelling”。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 多音节形容词的最高级需加“most”，且前加“the”，是固定用法。

questions.question: The farther we travel from the city center, the less crowded the neighborhoods become, and the more affordable housing prices are.
questions.explanation: “far”的比较级“farther”表距离，“little”的比较级“less”修饰不可数名词“crowdedness”（隐含），“affordable”的比较级“more affordable”符合多音节词规则，结构与逻辑均正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: “far”的比较级“farther”表具体距离，“further”表抽象程度（如further study）。

questions.question: When evaluating historical events, a ______ perspective is ______ likely to account for multiple viewpoints than a narrow, one-sided approach.
questions.explanation: 第一空单音节形容词“broad”的比较级为“broader”；第二空“than”提示用比较级，多音节形容词“likely”前加“more”。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 以“-d”结尾的单音节形容词，比较级直接加“-er”（如broad→broader）。

questions.question: This is the least practical solution to the problem, as it requires more time and resources than the other two options combined.
questions.explanation: “little”的最高级“least”修饰形容词“practical”，表“最不实用”；“more time and resources than”表比较级，搭配“the other two options”，逻辑与语法均正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: “least”是“little”的最高级，可修饰形容词或不可数名词，表“最不……”。

questions.question: Among the three art movements, Impressionism is ______ known to the general public, while Cubism is ______ understood due to its abstract nature.
questions.explanation: 第一空“well”的比较级为“better”，表“更知名”；第二空“little”的比较级为“less”，表“较难理解”，两者均为两者以上的隐含对比。
questions.knowledgeExtension: “well”的比较级是“better”，最高级是“best”，属于不规则变化。

questions.question: The more you invest in employee training, the more productive your team will be—this is why companies with the most comprehensive training programs often have the higher profit margins.
questions.explanation: “the most comprehensive”是最高级，对应“companies”的范围，“higher”应改为“highest”，与前文最高级保持一致，题干存在比较级与最高级混用错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 同一语境中，若前文用最高级，后文对应比较也需用最高级，保持逻辑一致。

questions.question: When comparing the two philosophical theories, Theory A is ______ in logical consistency, while Theory B is ______ in real-world applicability.
questions.explanation: 第一空多音节形容词“consistent”的比较级为“more consistent”；第二空多音节形容词“applicable”的比较级为“more applicable”（省略“applicable”以避免重复）。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 多音节形容词（3个及以上音节）的比较级必须加“more”，不能直接加“-er”。

questions.question: She is the better of the two lawyers, as her track record of winning cases is far more impressive than her colleague’s.
questions.explanation: “the+比较级+of the two”是两者比较的固定结构，“better”是“good”的比较级；“more impressive than”表比较级，搭配“her colleague’s”，逻辑与语法均正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 两者比较时，比较级前加“the”表“两者中较……的一个”，是固定用法。

questions.question: The ______ the temperature of a gas, the ______ its volume will be—this is described by Charles’s Law in chemistry.
questions.explanation: “the+比较级，the+比较级”结构中，单音节形容词“high”“large”的比较级直接加“-er”，表“温度越高，体积越大”的化学定律。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 单音节形容词的比较级变化是英语语法的基础规则，需熟练掌握常见词的变化形式。

questions.question: This is the most unique architectural design I’ve ever seen, as no other building combines traditional and modern elements in such a creative way.
questions.explanation: “unique”（独特的）是绝对形容词，表极限状态，不能用最高级“most unique”修饰，题干存在语义矛盾。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 绝对形容词（如unique/perfect/empty）本身无程度差异，不能用比较级/最高级修饰。

questions.question: Of all the renewable energy sources, solar power is becoming ______ accessible, and it is now one of the ______ viable alternatives to fossil fuels.
questions.explanation: 第一空多音节形容词“accessible”的比较级为“more accessible”；第二空“one of the+最高级+复数名词”中，多音节形容词“viable”的最高级为“most viable”。
questions.knowledgeExtension: “one of the+最高级+复数名词”是表“最……之一”的固定结构，需加“the”。

questions.question: The more diverse a team is in terms of background and experience, the more creative their solutions to complex problems tend to be.
questions.explanation: “diverse”的比较级“more diverse”符合多音节词规则；“creative”的比较级“more creative”同理，“the+比较级，the+比较级”结构使用正确，逻辑通顺。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 多音节形容词在“the+比较级，the+比较级”结构中，需完整使用“more+原级”，不能省略“more”。

questions.question: When comparing the two economic policies, Policy X is ______ effective in reducing inflation, while Policy Y is ______ beneficial for long-term economic growth.
questions.explanation: 两者比较中，多音节形容词“effective”“beneficial”的比较级均需加“more”，表“更有效”“更有益”。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 双音节及以上形容词的比较级均需加“more”，是英语语法的核心规则之一。

questions.question: He is the most experienced doctor in the hospital, and his success rate in treating rare diseases is higher than any doctor in the region.
questions.explanation: “higher than any doctor”包含自身（他是该地区医生之一），逻辑错误，需改为“higher than any other doctor”以排除自身。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 同一范围内的比较需用“any other+单数名词”，不同范围用“any+单数名词”，避免逻辑矛盾。
